section.text: Can store and retrieve items (up to 5k weight) from the spirit void for 5 [color=770000][tile=spirit anim=spirit] Spirit[/color].
Do you want to build this staircase for {points} [color=770000][tile=colosseum.points anim=colosseum.points] Spirit Points[/color]?
You need {points} [color=770000][tile=colosseum.points anim=colosseum.points] Spirit Points[/color] to unlock this staircase.
This costs a [item=focus_gem] (you have [global=gems] total). Would you like use a [item=focus_gem]?
This costs a [item=focus_gem]. You do not have any [item=focus_gem]s to spend.
Welcome! I am very excited to see a living creature in the flesh! We don't get many visitors to the spirit world anymore.
You may call me the Beastmaster. I have been studying creatures like you for a long time.
This game room is my favorite - I have created copies of many dangerous creatures in their native environment - you can fight any of them just by entering a door!

Don't worry about dying - like most of the spirit world, nothing in those rooms is fully real. However, if you beat them, I'll award you [color=770000][tile=colosseum.points anim=colosseum.points] Spirit Points[/color] which I can help you exchange for special prizes!
Would you like to learn about any of the creatures here?
These beasts are fast and have dangerous [item=horn]s, but move endlessly back and forth and are easy to predict. Try keeping your distance and hitting them from behind.
Unlike many enemies, you can't hide under Yetis to attack them from behind. Try staying on the move and sneaking in hits while avoiding its icy breath and snowballs.

Like most groups, bandits aren't that dangerous one on one, but don't let them gang up on you! Pick them off one at a time, and pay special attention to the bandit with the heavy shield, he can only be hurt from behind!

With no ranged weapon, the Dragon's a challenge. Hit [key=defend] to block flames with the shield or hide behind tiles until it flies back to its den, then hit it from behind as much as you can, and don't forget [item=attack_potion]s!
This beast won't attack you - but it can only be hurt by striking its open mouth! While its brood of [item=wyrm]s are dangerous, they are a good source of [item=dragonblood] if you need to heal.

Beware the Golemech's eye attack - it takes time to recharge, but it is incredibly powerful. [color=770000][tile=plant.ico] Plant[/color] and [color=770000][tile=water.ico] Water[/color] attacks are effective against it.
The Old One has powerful attacks and is only vulnerable when it overheats and opens up its armor. Dodge or block its attacks with the shield, then hit it when vulnerable.

The [item=shadow_cape] will help you avoid being attacked by both Mirrows at once. It will make you invisible every 5 seconds, allowing you to sneakily defeat one of them. You can also use [item=landmine]s while hidden for extra damage!

The Pirates have powerful laser weapons, but their range and speed are less than yours. Keep moving and firing, taking as few hits as possible, destroy one at a time, and they aren't that challenging.

This monster of the deep is very hazardous. Its arms are dangerous, and while they can be blasted off at the base, they regrow quickly. Destroy and get past the arms, then fire at the eyes to defeat it.

The Cultivator is weak to [color=770000][tile=fire.ico] Fire[/color] attacks. Burn it from the air where only its spores can hurt you. You will have to dodge the spores, as you don't have a lot of health for many hits.

The Storm can only be hurt by powerful [color=770000][tile=fire.ico] Fire[/color] attacks. Beware its tornado form, it is invulnerable and dangerous during that time. Climb the ruins to burn it when vulnerable, and run when it's in tornado form.
How about spending those [color=770000][tile=colosseum.points anim=colosseum.points] Spirit Points[/color] for some nice rewards!
